description: Configure the workspace's commerce settings: default and additional currencies, whether prices include tax, tax rates, shipping methods, custom order fields, stock thresholds, cart limits, session lifetimes and the B2B toggles. Only provided fields change; arrays replace the whole list. companyTaxRounding is the workspace's VAT rounding for company buyers who read net prices (a company can override it with set_company_tax_rounding); consumers are always rounded per_line. sellerCountry and reverseChargeNote drive reverse charge: a company with a verified EU VAT id of another member state (set_company_vat_verified) pays 0% VAT and its orders carry the note. An order shipped out of the EU VAT area, or to any other country from a sellerCountry outside the EU, is zero-rated as an export for any buyer, with exportNote on the order. Nothing is converted between currencies: a sales channel sells in one of them (create_sales_channel currency), and every price in an additional currency is set explicitly (set_product_currency_prices, set_product_variants, set_price_list_entries currency, shippingMethods currencyPrices). Which models the store sells is not set here: a model is sellable when its product capability is enabled (update_model, product.enabled).

additionalCurrencies.description: Other currencies the workspace sells in through sales channels, at most 9; replaces the list, [] removes them all. Removing one a sales channel sells in is refused (CURRENCY_IN_USE). Prices in a removed currency are kept but price nothing

autoCloseOrders.description: Close an order once it is paid and fulfilled, reopen it when that stops being true (default on)

companyTaxRounding.description: How VAT is rounded for company buyers who read net prices: per_line (default) rounds each line, per_rate rounds once per rate. A company can override it with set_company_tax_rounding; consumers are always per_line

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR - the catalogue's base currency. Locked while any additional currency exists

enableQuoteRequests.description: B2B: let members turn a cart into a quote request

enableSavedCarts.description: B2B: let members save carts for later

exportNote.description: Legal note frozen on export orders (goods shipped out of the EU VAT area, or from a seller outside the EU to another country), up to 500 characters, e.g. the local export provision; null or empty restores the default wording

loggedInTTLDays.description: Days a signed-in member's cart survives without activity (1-365)

maxItemsPerCart.description: Distinct lines a cart may hold (1-50)

maxQuantityPerItem.description: Units of one line a cart may hold (1-999)

orderFields.description: Custom fields kept on every order. Replaces the whole list; removing a field keeps the values orders already hold.

customerCanSet.description: Offered at checkout and shown back to the customer; otherwise staff only

key.description: Identifier the value is stored under, e.g. giftMessage

options.description: Choices of a select field; required for select, refused otherwise

required.description: Checkout refuses an order without it; only with customerCanSet

pricesIncludeTax.description: True when catalogue prices are gross (tax inside)

returnWindowDays.description: Days after delivery a customer may request a return from the storefront; null = no limit. The merchant can always open one

reverseChargeNote.description: Legal note frozen on reverse-charge orders, up to 500 characters; null or empty restores the default Article 196 wording

sellerCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the workspace sells from, e.g. PL (Greece is GR, not its VAT prefix EL); null clears it. Reverse charge needs it: a company with a verified EU VAT id of another member state is zero-rated (set_company_vat_verified). Goods shipped out of the EU VAT area, or from a seller outside the EU to any other country, are zero-rated as an export

sessionTTLDays.description: Days a guest cart survives without activity (1-365)

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the method ships to; omit or [] for everywhere

currencyPrices.description: The method's price and subtotal bounds in additional currencies; price, minSubtotal, maxSubtotal and freeAbove above are in the default currency. A cart in a currency the method has no price in is not offered the method. Omit to keep the stored ones; [] clears them

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies

freeAbove.description: Free from this subtotal (minor units); null = never

maxSubtotal.description: Offered only up to this subtotal (minor units); null = no cap

minSubtotal.description: Offered only from this subtotal (minor units); null = no floor

freeAbove.description: Shipping is free from this cart subtotal (minor units); null = never

maxSubtotal.description: Offered only up to this cart subtotal (minor units); null = no cap

minSubtotal.description: Offered only from this cart subtotal (minor units); null = no floor

price.description: Shipping charge, minor units of the default currency

taxRateId.description: Tax rate applied to the shipping charge; omit to leave it untaxed
